sourceBasis.meaning: CREATE fills an unset OomKillDisable pointer with false.
Before starting, it revalidates and may adjust the stored HostConfig.
When the kernel capability is unsupported, a present OomKillDisable value is cleared to nil, including false. Only true emits the warning.
The cgroup-v2 profile sets OomKillDisable support false.
